Hi team — looping in a short summary of what we'll run and our recommendations so Tom has visibility before Thu's call.

What we'll evaluate (on the 5k sample):
- Models: run lightweight comparisons across two candidate embeddings (open-llm-1536 and open-llm-768) plus a quantized 1536 variant.
- Metrics: Recall@10, MRR@10, mean cosine similarity within same-canonical-product groups, and nearest-neighbor false positive rate (top-10).
- Drift check: compute per-quarter centroid shifts, distributional drift (KS test on cosine sims), and a simple regression-based degradation check on retrieval accuracy.

Preliminary guidance (based on similar workloads):
- Short product descriptions often do well with 768 dims for cost/latency, but 1536 gives better separability for long help articles and reduces nearest-neighbor collisions. If StorageMap needs consistent cross-type retrieval (short+long), we usually recommend mixed strategy: 768 for product_short_desc indexing for speed, 1536 for help_article embeddings used in long-form similarity and rerank.
- Drift handling: prefer monitoring + incremental re-embedding rather than permanently lowering dimensionality. Lower dims can hide signal; monitoring + automated re-embed on centroid shift gives better long-term quality.
- Quality regression: we'll run a small eval set of ~200 annotated pairs you can sanity-check; we'll surface any regression after quantization or model switching.

Deliverables and timeline: preliminary metrics within 48 hours of receiving the sample (drift diagnostics + recommended config), full PDF report + prompt set and suggested thresholds within 5 business days. Attachments: small benchmark report stub and the prompt set CSV (attached to this thread).

Action items for Tom: grant read access to the sample in the Drive link and confirm Thu 8:30am PT for the review call.
